buildIdeas.title: Anchor Framework Migration Assistant CLI
buildIdeas.description: Build a CLI tool that automatically upgrades Anchor programs from v0.29 to v0.30+ with breaking change detection, IDL migration, and test suite validation. This addresses the stabilization phase where developers need safe upgrade paths as Anchor reaches maturity.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Anchor commit activity declining (-29) signals stabilization; developers upgrading existing programs need automated migration tools. The z-score 3.3 on solana-program-library indicates renewed infrastructure focus, making this a high-value developer experience improvement.

buildIdeas.title: Solana Program Benchmark Suite & Gas Profiler
buildIdeas.description: Create a standardized benchmarking framework that profiles compute units, memory usage, and transaction costs across Solana programs with CI/CD integration. Fills the gap between local testing and mainnet performance as core infrastructure matures.
buildIdeas.whyNow: With Anchor stabilizing and SPL reaching maturity (z-score 5.6), developers need standardized performance profiling tools. This enables best practices adoption across the ecosystem as infrastructure focus shifts from feature development to optimization.

buildIdeas.title: Validator Economics Dashboard & Staking Optimizer
buildIdeas.description: Build a real-time dashboard aggregating validator commission rates, MEV rewards (via Jito), uptime metrics, and APY calculations with portfolio optimization recommendations. Addresses the shift from MEV extraction to sustainable validator economics as jito-solana decelerates (-86 commits) and stakenet accelerates.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Jito stakenet showing +7 commits while jito-solana declining (-86) indicates ecosystem transition to validator staking infrastructure. Validators need better tools to optimize returns as MEV markets mature; this captures the emerging validator-focused narrative.

buildIdeas.title: DEX Liquidity Aggregation & Smart Order Router
buildIdeas.description: Develop a smart order router that splits trades across HumidiFi, BisonFi, Orca, and Raydium to minimize slippage and capture arbitrage opportunities. Addresses liquidity fragmentation (-30% to -39% volume declines) by providing unified execution across emerging venues.
buildIdeas.whyNow: DEX volume contracting (-30% to -39%) while new venues (HumidiFi, BisonFi) emerge creates fragmentation. Smart routing captures value from fragmentation and helps traders navigate the multi-venue landscape, directly addressing the z-score 3.53 volume concentration signal.

buildIdeas.title: Stablecoin Yield Aggregator with Volatility Hedging
buildIdeas.description: Build a yield aggregator that routes stablecoin deposits across lending protocols (Marginfi, Solend, Drift) while automatically hedging SOL price exposure via perpetual shorts. Captures the $252.9M net inflow signal indicating sophisticated capital repositioning.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Strong net stablecoin inflow ($252.9M, accelerating momentum) signals capital hedging against volatility. This tool enables sophisticated traders to earn yield while maintaining downside protection, directly monetizing the detected capital rebalancing narrative.

buildIdeas.title: Memecoin Launchpad with Liquidity Lock & Vesting
buildIdeas.description: Create a memecoin launchpad improving upon pump.fun with built-in liquidity locks, team token vesting, and anti-rug mechanisms. Addresses ecosystem maturation (market cap stable at $3.63B despite volatility) by providing infrastructure for quality projects.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Memecoin category showing ecosystem consolidation (stable $3.63B cap) with top performers UP (+148.7%), OSAK (+68.2%) indicating quality differentiation. Market is ready for infrastructure improvements beyond pump.fun; PENGU and SOL trending on CoinGecko shows sustained retail interest.

buildIdeas.title: AI Agent Trading Framework with Solana Integration
buildIdeas.description: Extend solana-agent-kit with pre-built trading strategies (DCA, grid trading, arbitrage) and risk management modules, enabling non-technical users to deploy autonomous agents. Bridges the gap between LLM frameworks and onchain execution as the ecosystem moves from proof-of-concept to production.
buildIdeas.whyNow: solana-agent-kit gaining traction (+2 stars, z-score 2.11) with nascent ecosystem still in proof-of-concept phase. AI agents represent the next frontier for retail participation; building production-ready strategies now captures early adoption as the narrative accelerates.

buildIdeas.title: Lending Protocol Risk Dashboard & Liquidation Monitor
buildIdeas.description: Build a real-time risk monitoring dashboard tracking collateral ratios, liquidation thresholds, and protocol health metrics across Drift, Marginfi, Solend, and Kamino. Provides transparency for the mature lending ecosystem (1000 tx each, z-score 0.52) with normalized usage patterns.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Lending protocols showing stable, normalized activity (1000 tx each) indicate product-market fit and mature phase. Users need better risk visibility; this dashboard captures value from the established ecosystem without requiring protocol-level changes.

buildIdeas.title: Validator Client Monitoring & Failover Orchestration
buildIdeas.description: Build an orchestration layer that monitors Anza (Agave) and Firedancer clients, automatically switching between them on failure and tracking performance metrics. Enables validators to leverage client diversity (Anza, Firedancer) while reducing operational complexity.

buildIdeas.description: Create a Solana NFT analytics platform with rarity scoring, portfolio tracking, and market insights aggregating data from Magic Eden and Tensor. Enhances the mature NFT infrastructure (1000 tx each, z-score 0.52) with better discovery and portfolio management tools.
buildIdeas.whyNow: NFT marketplaces showing stable, consolidated activity (1000 tx each) with feature-complete platforms. Users need better analytics and discovery tools; this captures value from the mature infrastructure without competing on marketplace execution.

buildIdeas.title: Wormhole Bridge Monitoring & Cross-Chain Arbitrage Bot
buildIdeas.description: Build a monitoring dashboard and arbitrage bot that detects price discrepancies across Wormhole-connected chains and executes profitable trades. Leverages Wormhole's renewed GitHub attention (+3 stars, z-score 3.28) to capture cross-chain value flows.
buildIdeas.whyNow: Wormhole gaining GitHub traction (+3 stars, z-score 3.28) with multi-chain topics indicates renewed focus on interoperability. Cross-chain arbitrage represents high-value opportunity as bridge infrastructure matures; this captures the emerging connectivity narrative.

buildIdeas.title: Decentralized Compute Job Marketplace & Scheduler
